No passage proposes or studies this integration; P3 discusses AFSD for HEAs but not peening, while P6 applies ultrasonic peening to laser AM parts, not AFSD. The idea of synchronizing peening during solid-state deposition to simultaneously refine grains and induce compressive stresses is a non-trivial synthesis that goes beyond the individual findings.
